snippet.title: Paper Detour - Grain Test 02 | Stronger Grain | 15 seconds | 4K | Private Review
snippet.description: Private technical grain review, not a release. Same 15-second Paper Detour 030 parallax excerpt (source frames 811-1260, V07-V09). PD Grain 02: luma-only grain at four times the previous amplitude (peak RMS 4.8 eight-bit luma codes), Gaussian sigma 1.0 UHD pixels, temporal correlation 0.65, protected shadows and highlights. Grain added after 1080p-to-2160p resizing. Existing accepted camera, parallax and audio retained; no audio remix. Compare 2160p and 1080p playback. This candidate awaits visual approval and does not change production defaults.
